title: Find Me Hubby
description: Find Me Hubby — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Audrey the Alchemist

Quest Type: Discover

Quest Description: Find Audrey the Alchemist's hubby somewhere on Level 2 of Algernon.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Audrey the Alchemist

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Demorale Majority

Zone: Algernon

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Find Audrey the Alchemist's hubby somewhere on Level 2 of Algernon.

Offer:

Hello there, Dungeon Runner. I seem to have a slight problem and 'haps you can help me with it? That would be so very kind of you. You see, my husband is nowhere to be found! He told me some story about investigating these problems with the Rattles in Algernon, but I don't believe him! Not one bit! I bet he is out gallavanting around, running Dungeons with his friends instead of at home feeding our precious, wesious wittle kitties. Eekee, ChinChin, Bubby, Willfun, Jyro, Liono, Skip-Skip, Frannie, Dalia, Battle Kit, Gunthar, Lambykinn, Voooom, Mrrrr, Xia, Pomp, and Hekh are going to be right cross with him! Just you see!

So be a peach and find him for me? Last I heard, he was investigating around Level 2 of Algernon. You simply must find him!

Turn-in:

Wait, you said my wife sent me? Wife?! Audrey?! Oh that is a riot! I'm not married, never have been, and certainly would not marry Audrey--I'm allergic to cats. Cats and crazy. I think she may be sampling a bit too much of her wares if you catch my drift.

Well you are here now, how about helping in my investigations?

Objectives:

  • Locate Hubby

Level range: 3–20
